theme: Turning off the parts nobody is using
title: Turning Off the Parts Nobody Is Using: Power-Gating Partition
strategies: hold everything on forever, never gate anything (trivial baseline)

gate as fine-grained as possible (one domain per block, round-robin pack when the domain cap binds) and gate every idle run regardless of length (greedy, the obvious 'turn it off whenever idle' recipe)

compute the size-scaled idle-run breakeven threshold from L, W and each candidate domain's size, then run true agglomerative clustering (re-pricing every merge's exact net energy delta after each step) to decide which blocks may share a domain, taking free merges and paying for forced ones cheapest-first until the domain cap is met (strong)
exact joint optimum over all partitions and thresholds (open ceiling, uncovered -- partitioning into <=D domains to minimize coverage loss is a hard combinatorial clustering problem)
